=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:651-664 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In _heal_regression_budget_only, the per-clause loop checks HEAL_RG_UNCHANGED_RE.search(clause) and runs `continue` before it checks HEAL_RG_KNOB_RE.search(clause). A clause that raises a knob and also says "no change", "untouched", "as-is" or "do not change" therefore drops the knob, and `knob_seen` stays False. Example: "Raise `PHASE_TIMEOUT` to 90 with no change to the job steps".
  WHY: A timeout-only plan with this wording makes the function return False at line 665. parse_heal_regression then approves it as `not_a_regression`/`regression_named`, and plan.yml auto-posts /approved instead of holding it as `budget_only_plan`. This is the case the issue #8543 gate exists to hold, and the last run made it possible. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:629-634 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Files-bullet fallback `first = (spans or words or [""])[0]` records the first non-knob word of a prose bullet as a file when the bullet has no backticks and no path-like token. For example, "- Raise PHASE_TIMEOUT from 40 to 90" records "Raise". The bullet is never added to `other`, so its knob is never scanned.
  WHY: "Raise" fails HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE at lines 642-644 and the function returns False. Whether a timeout-only plan is held or auto-approved then depends only on backtick formatting, which contradicts the docstring at lines 591-594 and the agents.d fragment. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:625-628 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `if pathlike: files.append(pathlike[0]); continue` keeps only the path from a Files bullet and drops the rest of the bullet. A knob on the same bullet is never scanned, for example "- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: raise `timeout-minutes` from 30 to 60".
  WHY: If the rest of the plan names no knob, `knob_seen` stays False and line 665 returns False, so a timeout-only plan is auto-approved instead of held as `budget_only_plan`. The docstring and agents.d say knob text in a Files bullet is scanned, but that is true only for bullets without a path. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:452-454 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comment above HEAL_RG_UNCHANGED_RE still says "(knobs still count)". Since the per-clause change, knobs in an unchanged clause no longer count, so the comment contradicts the comment at lines 458-459, the docstring at lines 593-594 and the agents.d fragment.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the next editor is told the opposite of what the code does, and this is the behaviour behind the first finding. Both reviewers rated it NIT; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash noted the same stale comment inside its line 655-657 finding and in its hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, lines 655-659 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "unchanged" check runs before the knob check. A clause that raises a knob and also contains "no change", "untouched", "as-is" or "do not change" drops the knob, because the clause split only breaks on `;`, `,`, `.`, and, but and while. Example: "Raise `PHASE_TIMEOUT` to 90 with no change to the job steps".
  WHY: If no other knob is named, `knob_seen` stays False and line 665 returns False. A plan whose Files lists only `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is then approved (`not_a_regression`/`regression_named`), and plan.yml posts /approved. Suggested fix: still count the knob when the clause has a raise or increase verb (about 3 lines).
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, lines 629-632 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The bare-token fallback looks only at the first token. For "- Raise PHASE_TIMEOUT from 40 to 90" it records "Raise" as a file, which fails HEAL_RG_WORKFLOW_PATH_RE at line 642, and line 644 returns False.
  WHY: Whether the plan is held or approved depends only on backtick formatting. Suggested fix: use the fallback only when `len(spans or words) == 1`.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:_heal_regression_budget_only, lines 626-628 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A path-bearing Files bullet is never scanned, so a knob on that bullet is missed. This contradicts the docstring and the agents.d fragment.
  WHY: `knob_seen` stays False and line 665 returns False, so the plan is auto-approved. This was already the behaviour before the last run. Suggested fix: `other.append((bullet.group(1).replace(pathlike[0], " "), False))` before `continue`.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:lines 452-454 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment "(knobs still count)" above HEAL_RG_UNCHANGED_RE contradicts the code and the lines 458-459 comment.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime; the next editor is misled.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- scripts/partial_delivery.py:lines 625-628 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

  WHY: `knob_seen` stays False and the plan is approved as `not_a_regression` instead of held as `budget_only_plan`.
- scripts/partial_delivery.py:line 453 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
